text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука lives up to her moniker
of the
Otherworldly Front-Runner and
takes first at the
autumn Tenno Sho in a
whirlwind victory.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Cheers of celebration for her victory ring
out over
the Tokyo Racecourse for what
seems like
forever.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
